GenAiPlugin.description: Responds to an email that requests to opt a lead out of receiving emails by opting the lead out of receiving emails. Call this topic if the user would like to be no longer included, contacted or reachable in the future, or if the user would like us to stop and refrain from future actions resembling to those leading up to the email, or If the user is not interested. Always call this topic if the email content requests to stop receiving messages or to opt out or not ready at the moment.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If lead or prospect has requested to stop receiving messages, or to opt out, you must perform the Opt Out Lead action.

If lead or prospect has replied "Opt Out" or "I don't want to receive these emails" or "Unsubscribe" or “stop emailing” or similar terms to stop receiving messages. you must always execute OptOutLead action.

If lead or prospect has replied "Not Interested" , "Not ready at the moment", "I am not looking for right now" or similar terms other than Opt Out you must always execute SDRNotInterestedLeadTarget action.
You must always use context variables for the input of this action

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to only to respond to an email that requests to opt a lead out and Not interested of receiving emails by opting the lead out of receiving emails.
